plain: In agreement with; fitting well together.

webster.text: Agreeing; according; congruous; consistent; followed generally by to; sometimes by with; as, this rule is consonant to scripture and reason.

more.text: A letter, so named because it is considered as being sounded only in connection with a vowel.

example.quote: It is a rule not enjoined upon the courts by legislative provision, but adopted by themselves, as consonant to truth and propriety, for the direction of their conduct as interpreters of the law.
